TEXT.English: An Achaemenid provincial records and tax administration complex. Replaces the Courthouse.
Functions as a Courthouse and directly adds +2 Gold and +1 Espionage.
Darius' Achaemenid Persia only. Build on flat land (not Flood Plains), inside your city radius, on an existing Road. Hard cap: 5 Royal Stations per player.
A royal caravanserai and courier waypoint on imperial roads. Base effect: +1 Commerce on Road. Additional Commerce scales with nearby city centers in a 9x9 area.
